representedDate: Standing post-2011 cathedral, shown by the 2018 canonization exterior photographs and the present cathedral historical account.
wholePhysicalScope: Exact mapped cathedral walls, facade with twin tower blocks, transverse wings and nave buttresses.
lodDetails: The four levels retain the cruciform plan, paired open belfries, recessed portal and crossing dome. Near levels add the nave windows, bell forms, balustrades and dome ribs.
limitations: Dome section, side openings, bell openings and secondary roof pitches beyond the two main viewpoints will be estimated from the named exterior sources and mapped perimeter.
The photographed nighttime illumination and event projections are temporary. Permanent exterior finishes are interpreted separately.
